story.title: Our Story
content: Echo was founded in 2018, born from deep thinking about network data transmission efficiency. We saw the urgent need for stable, high-speed data transmission services in the context of globalization, and decided to build a professional network mirror service platform.

Through years of technical accumulation and service optimization, Echo has developed into an industry-leading mirror service provider. We serve over 1000 enterprise customers and have deployed service nodes in more than 50 countries and regions worldwide, providing stable and reliable mirror services to millions of users.
We believe that the value of technology lies in solving real problems. Echo is not just a technology company, but a reliable partner on your digital transformation journey.

items.answer: Yes, we provide private deployment solutions and can customize dedicated mirror services according to your needs.

items.answer: We promise 99.9% service availability and provide 24/7 technical support and monitoring services.
